description:
Additional Manager Notes: 
 Candidate can work either from Tempe, AZ or Mounds View, MN site 
 They will have on going requirement of one or two up gradation each year, new release or adding more functionalities to the MES application. 
 This position has possibilities of extension and conversion to full time. 
 They will have a team of 4 developers, this person will be focused on backend/server side Java development. 
 Jboss experience is strongly desired, manager will also look at the resume with other server experience like Tomcat. 
 Must Have: 
 Java 
 Web Services (preferably Webfil) 
 Oracle (any version above 10) 
 Desired: 
 VB6 
 Medical Devices manufacturing industry experience 
 Experience in writing java test scripts 
 
 Education Required: 
 BA/BS Information systems, computer science, information technology. 
 Years of Experience Required: 10+ years 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Work as a IT Developer for the Factory Works Team! The IT Developer position will provide development efforts into the Factory Works 9.4 release version. Most of the work consist in web services created in Java using Jboss as a server. The web services are consumed by client machines in manufacturing floor. This position provide integrated systems planning and recommend innovative technologies that will enhance the current system. Establish and communicate architecture and design tenets and ensure compliance in all relevant areas focused on driving mobile application development, deployment and support activities. 

 Kind Regards, 
 Damini somvanshi 
 Technical recruiter
